summary: Iteration 12 retest of the iteration_11 fixes plus extras removal and owner price changes. Backend: new suite test_iter12_extras_prices_recurring_fixes.py passes 12/12. It covers: the 6 extras are gone from config, services and admin settings (14 left); blinds/windows/balcony per-item still work; removed keys are ignored in quotes; an owner PUT /admin/settings to blinds +3 and weekly 25% changes the config and quote straight away, then is restored; the booking doc's residential summary; the cron advances next_date when the visit already exists AND when finalize fails (no quote); the child reference starts with SO-; the monthly anchor 31 -> 30 -> 31; the child confirmation email and owner email include Services and Other requests; resuming a paused plan with a past next_date rolls forward past today (in 7-day steps); PATCH cancelled and cancel-refund on the first booking cancel the plan; cancelling a non-first booking leaves the plan alone. Regression: iter11 11/11, iter9 and iter8 pass. iter10 has 6 failures, but only because those tests still expect the removed extras (sofa, mattress, wall_washing, 20 extras). Real end to end in the UI: rapid frequency switching ended on the correct weekly price. The Services step add-ons show 14 extras, none of the removed ones. The review and aside show '-£24.40'. Pay £138.29 went to Stripe, was paid with 4242, and /payment/success showed payment-recurring-note. The plan was created active with next 2026-11-02 and anchor 26. The customer email has Services, Other requests and the regular-clean note. The owner email has Services and Other requests. Admin booking detail shows Frequency, People, Pets, Last cleaned, booking-detail-res-services and booking-detail-other-request, with no Condition row, and the discount shows as -£24.40. Pause hides Next visit and shows the paused message; resume works. Settings UI: blinds 11 and weekly 20% saved; the booking form showed 'Save 20%', 'Blinds cleaning × 1 £11.00' and a 20% discount line. Restored to 8 / 15 (checked in the DB). /quote EoT extras step: 14 extras and the right price. The carpet service shows the carpet request link. Cancelling the real first booking via PATCH cancelled its plan. All TEST data was deleted.

minor.issue: If the off-session charge succeeds but finalize_booking raises (e.g. a missing or invalid quote_id), the plan advances (good). But the child booking stays pending_payment with a paid payment_transaction, last_result is not set, and nobody is told: the customer is charged with no confirmed visit. Reproduced in the test plan 'TEST_ Plan12 NoQuote' (traceback in backend.err.log).

The owner 'New booking' email has Services and Other requests but not the frequency, people, pets or last cleaned, and no 'regular weekly clean - auto-charged' note. The owner can't tell from the email that it's a recurring plan.
It doesn't check the current status. Re-cancelling an already cancelled booking re-runs _cancel_effects and sends a duplicate cancellation email (existing behaviour).

issues: Adaptive Pricing showed US$192.31 selected by default for the tester location, with £138.29 as the alternative. For a UK GBP-only business with saved-card GBP off-session charges, consider turning off Adaptive Pricing / multi-currency in the Stripe dashboard.

action_items: Update /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_extras_results.py for the removed extras (it still expects 20 extras and sofa/mattress/wall_washing). 6 tests fail only for this reason.

In _create_and_charge, wrap finalize_booking: on failure after a successful charge, set last_result 'paid_not_confirmed' (or similar), log, and notify the owner so the paid visit isn't left pending_payment silently.
Optional: add the frequency, people, pets and last cleaned and a 'regular clean - auto-charged' line to the owner new-booking email.
Optional: make PATCH cancelled idempotent (skip _cancel_effects if already cancelled).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_recurring._charge_visit: try/finally advances next_date with a conditional filter on next_date. Good. Exceptions still bubble up to run_recurring and are only logged.
Child visits are not re-checked against slot capacity or blocked days (accepted by design per E1).
residential_summary.services lists only the residential tasks. Add-ons (extras) appear only in the price lines (fine, but the owner email shows only the tasks).
The ResidentialBooking reqId guard correctly drops stale preview responses. The gbp() negative format is fixed globally.

success_rate.backend: 100% of iter12 tests (12/12); regression 50/56 - all 6 failures are obsolete iter10 assertions about removed extras

seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ / test_res12_* bookings, plans, leads, quotes, communications, payment_transactions and Stripe customers were deleted. Settings were restored (blinds 8, weekly 15%, 14 extras).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://solid-clean-ai.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_iter12_extras_prices_recurring_fixes.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. The server date is Oct 2026. On Stripe checkout, the first .SubmitButton click sometimes doesn't submit; wait about 8s and click again. After any UI booking, run backend/tests/cleanup_iter12_ui.py (it cancels via the API, checks the plan cascade, then deletes test_res12_* data). Settings testids: settings-extras-{key}-price, settings-res-freq-{key}-discount, settings-save-btn.
